title: Worksheet 10: Cloud Computing
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: Cloud computing refers to storing data and running programs over the internet on remote servers, instead of storing everything directly on a person's own computer or device. When someone saves a photo to a cloud storage service, or uses an online program to edit a document, they are actually sending that information over the internet to be stored or processed on powerful computers located in large facilities called data centers, which may be located far away, even in a different country. This offers several benefits: a person can access their files from any device with an internet connection, they don't have to worry as much about losing information if their own device breaks, and companies can use as much computing power as they need without buying and maintaining their own expensive equipment. However, cloud computing does have a downside: without an internet connection, a person often cannot access files or programs that are stored only in the cloud.

questions.text: Cloud computing is best described as:
questions.correct: Storing data and running programs over the internet on remote servers
distractors: A physical part of a computer

questions.text: According to the paragraph, where is cloud data actually stored?
questions.correct: On powerful computers in data centers
distractors: Only on the user's own device

questions.text: Which of the following is listed as a benefit of cloud computing?
questions.correct: A person can access files from any device with an internet connection
distractors: It removes the need for the internet
It makes devices run out of storage faster

questions.text: According to the paragraph, what is a downside of cloud computing?
questions.correct: Without internet access, a person often cannot reach cloud-only files
distractors: It deletes files automatically every day
It only works on one specific device

questions.text: According to the paragraph, why might companies use cloud computing?
questions.correct: To avoid buying and maintaining their own expensive equipment
distractors: Because it is required by law
Because it turns off automatically at night
Because it does not require electricity
